'''ǂUngkue''' is an extinct [[Tuu languages|ǃKwi]] language or dialect of the [[Vaal River]] region of [[South Africa]], with records of it being spoken in [[Warrenton, South Africa|Warrenton]]. It was recorded by [[Carl Meinhof]], and was closely related to the neighboring [[ǁKā language]] (or dialect) recorded by [[Dorothea Bleek]]; they in turn are related to [[Nǁng language|Nǁng]], which has a single remaining speaker as of 2023. It has the Bleek label ''SIIb''.

Like [[ǀXam language|ǀXam]], ǂUngkue used 'inclusory' pronouns for compound subjects:<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Meinhof |first=Carl |date=1928–1929 |title=Versuch einer grammatischen Skizze einer Buschmannsprache |url= |journal=Zeitschrift für Eingeborenensprachen |volume=XIX |issue=3 |pages=161–188}}</ref>
